H3870.d: probably from לוּז (as growing there); Luz, the name of two places in Palestine; Luz.

H3842.d: from לָבַן; properly, (the) white, i.e. the moon; moon. See also לְבָנָא.

H3977.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מֹאזֵן; {(only in the dual) a pair of scales}; balances.

H3922.d: from יָלַךְ; a journey; Lekah, a place in Palestine; Lecah.

H3511.d: from כָּאַב; suffering (physical or mental), adversity; grief, pain, sorrow.

H3541.d: from the prefix k and הוּא; properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now; also, here, + hitherto, like, on the other side, so (and much), such, on that manner, (on) this (manner, side, way, way and that way), + mean while, yonder.

H3913.d: a primitive root; properly, to hammer out (an edge), i.e. to sharpen; instructer, sharp(-en), whet.

H3728.d: a primitive root; to tread down; figuratively, to humiliate; cover.

H3614.d: probably by erroneous transcription for כָּלֵבִי; patronymically from כָּלֵב; a Calebite or descendant of Caleb; of the house of Caleb.

H3833.d: or (Ezekiel 19:2) לְבִיָּא; irregular masculine plural לְבָאִים; irregular feminine plural לְבָאוֹת; from an unused root meaning; compare אֲרִי; to roar; a lion (properly, a lioness as the fiercer (although not a roarer;)); (great, old, stout) lion, lioness, young (lion).

H3915.d: or (Isaiah 21:11) לֵיל; also לַיְלָה; from the same as לוּל; properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity; (mid-)night (season).
r: came to pass the same night

H3665.d: a primitive root; properly, to bend the knee; hence, to humiliate, vanquish; bring down (low), into subjection, under, humble (self), subdue.

H3556.d: probably from the same as כַּבּוֹן (in the sense of rolling) or כָּוָה (in the sense of blazing); a star (as round or as shining); figuratively, a prince; star(-gazer).

H3638.d: of foreign derivation; Kilmad, a place apparently in the Assyrian empire; Chilmad.

H3553.d: from an unused root meaning to be high or rounded; a helmet (as arched); helmet. Compare קוֹבַע.

H3650.d: redupl. from כָּמַר; obscuration (as if from shrinkage of light, i.e. an eclipse (only in plural); blackness.

H3695.d: a plural probably of foreign derivation; Casluchim, a people cognate to the Egyptians; Casluhim.

H3871.d: or לֻחַ; from a primitive root; probably meaning to glisten; a tablet (as polished), of stone, wood or metal; board, plate, table.

H3568.d: probably of foreign origin; Cush (or Ethiopia), the name of a son of Ham, and of his territory; also of an Israelite; Chush, Cush, Ethiopia.

H3991.d: lemma מַאֲפֵלְיָה second vowel, corrected to מַאְפֵלְיָה; prolonged feminine of מַאֲפֵל; opaqueness; darkness.

H3502.d: feminine of יֶתֶר; properly, excellence, i.e. (by implication) wealth; abundance, riches.

H3678.d: or כִּסֵּה; from כָּסָה; properly, covered, i.e. a throne (as canopied); seat, stool, throne.

H3685.d: the same as כְּסִיל; any notable constellation; specifically Orion (as if a burly one); constellation, Orion.

H3510.d: a primitive root; properly, to feel pain; by implication, to grieve; figuratively, to spoil; grieving, mar, have pain, make sad (sore), (be) sorrowful.
r: whom i have not made sad

H3716.d: feminine of כְּפִיר; the village (always with the art.); Kephirah, a place in Palestine; Chephirah.

H3561.d: from כּוּן; something prepared, i.e. a sacrificial wafer; cake.

H3647.d: a primitive root; to store away, i.e. (figuratively) in the memory; lay up in store.

H3626.d: from כֹּל and חֹזֶה; every seer; Col-Chozeh, an Israelite; Col-hozeh.

H3713.d: from כָּפַר; properly, a cover, i.e. (by implication) a tankard (or covered goblet); also white frost (as covering the ground); bason, hoar(-y) frost.

H3526.d: a primitive root; to trample; hence, to wash (properly, by stamping with the feet), whether literal (including the fulling process) or figurative; fuller, wash(-ing).

H3822.d: plural of לָבִיא; lionesses; Lebaoth, a place in Palestine; Lebaoth. See also בֵּית לְבָאוֹת.

H3894.d: or לָחֻם; passive participle of לָחַם; properly, eaten, i.e. food; also flesh, i.e. body; while...is eating, flesh.

H3840.d: from לָבַן; properly, whiteness, i.e. (by implication) transparency; paved.

H3790.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to כָּתַב; {to grave, by implication, to write (describe, inscribe, prescribe, subscribe)}; write(-ten).

H3792.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to כָּתָב; {something written, i.e. a writing, record or book}; prescribing, writing(-ten).

H3691.d: probably of foreign origin; Kisleu, the 9th Hebrew month; Chisleu.

H3823.d: a primitive root; properly, to be enclosed (as if with fat); by implication (as denominative from לֵבָב); to unheart; also as denominative from לָבִיבָה i.e.; (in a good sense) transport (with love), or (in a bad sense) stultify; to make cakes; make cakes, ravish, be wise.

H3723.d: from כָּפַר; a village (as protected by walls); village. Compare כְּפִיר.

H3940.d: or לַפִּד; from an unused root probably meaning to shine; a flambeau, lamp or flame; (fire-) brand, (burning) lamp, lightning, torch.

H3602.d: from כֹּה; just so, referring to the previous or following context; after that (this) manner, this matter, (even) so, in such a case, thus.

H3588.d: a primitive particle (the full form of the prepositional prefix) indicating causal relations of all kinds, antecedent or consequent; (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed; and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.

H3620.d: the same as כְּלוּבxlit kᵉlûb corrected to kᵉlûwb; Kelub, the name of two Israelites; Chelub.

H3645.d: or (Jeremiah 48:7) כְּמִישׁ; from an unused root meaning to subdue; the powerful; Kemosh, the god of the Moabites; Chemosh.

H3574.d: from כָּשֵׁר; prosperity; in plural freedom; [idiom] chain.

H3889.d: from לוּשׁ; kneading; Lush, a place in Palestine; Laish (from the margin). Compare לַיִשׁ.

H3854.d: from an unused root meaning to be eager; intense mental application; study.

H3783.d: from כָּשַׁל; properly, a tottering, i.e. ruin; fall.

H3708.d: or (in Job) כַּעַשׂ; from כַּעַס; vexation; anger, angry, grief, indignation, provocation, provoking, [idiom] sore, sorrow, spite, wrath.

H3976.d: from אָזַן; (only in the dual) a pair of scales; balances.

H3753.d: from כָּרַר; a dromedary (from its rapid motion as if dancing); swift beast.

H3960.d: a primitive root; properly, to lick; but used only as a denominative from לָשׁוֹן; to wag the tongue, i.e. to calumniate; accuse, slander.

H3882.d: from לָוָה; a wreathed animal, i.e. a serpent (especially the crocodile or some other large sea-monster); figuratively, the constellation of the dragon; also as a symbol of Babylon; leviathan, mourning.

H3975.d: feminine passive participle of אוֹר; something lighted, i.e. an aperture; by implication, a crevice or hole (of a serpent); den.

H3727.d: from כָּפַר; a lid (used only of the cover of the sacred Ark); mercy seat.
r: thee from above the mercy seat
side out of the mercy seat

H3500.d: the same as יֶתֶר; Jether, the name of five or six Israelites and of one Midianite; Jether, Jethro. Compare יִתְרוֹ.

H3501.d: by variation for יִתְרָה; Jithra, an Israelite (or Ishmaelite); Ithra.

H3832.d: a primitive root; to overthrow; intransposed, to fall; fall.

H3948.d: from לָקַח; properly, something received, i.e. (mentally) instruction (whether on the part of the teacher or hearer); also (in an active and sinister sense) inveiglement; doctrine, learning, fair speech.

H3739.d: usually assigned as a primitive root, but probably only a special application of כָּרָה (through the common idea of planning implied in a bargain); to purchase; buy, prepare.

H3644.d: or כָּמוֹ; (compare כֵּן); a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately as, thus, so; according to, (such) as (it were, well as), in comparison of, like (as, to, unto), thus, when, worth.
r: yea who knoweth not such things

H3855.d: from an unused root meaning to glow (compare לַהַב) or else to be earnest (compare לַהַג); Lahad, an Israelite; Lahad.

H3724.d: from כָּפַר; properly, a cover, i.e. (literally) a village (as covered in); (specifically) bitumen (as used for coating), and the henna plant (as used for dyeing); figuratively, a redemption-price; bribe, camphire, pitch, ransom, satisfaction, sum of money, village.

H3521.d: from the same as כֶּבֶל in the sense of limitation; sterile; Cabul, the name of two places in Palestine; Cabul.

H3877.d: from לוֹט; covering; Lotan, an Idumaean; Lotan.

H3874.d: a primitive root; to wrap up; cast, wrap.

H3649.d: from כָּמַר; properly, an ascetic (as if shrunk with self-maceration), i.e. an idolatrous priest (only in plural); Chemarims (idolatrous) priests.

H3779.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to כַּשְׂדִּי; a Chaldaean or inhabitant of Chaldaea; by implication, a Magian or professional astrologer; Chaldean.

H3867.d: a primitive root; properly, to twine, i.e. (by implication) to unite, to remain; also to borrow (as a form of obligation) or (caus.) to lend; abide with, borrow(-er), cleave, join (self), lend(-er).
r: thee that they may be joined
thee and thou shalt not lend

H3712.d: feminine of כַּף; a leaf of a palmtree; branch.

H3531.d: from כָּבַר in its original sense; a sieve (as netted); sieve.

H3662.d: from כָּנַן; planted; Kenani, an Israelite; Chenani.

H3850.d: from an unused root of uncertain signification; Lod, a place in Palestine; Lod.

H3730.d: or (Amos 9:1) כַּפְתּוֹר; probably from an unused root meaning to encircle; a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense, i.e. the capital of acolumn, or a wreath-like button or disk on the candelabrum; knop, (upper) lintel.

H3688.d: a primitive root; properly, to be fat, i.e. (figuratively) silly; be foolish.

H3636.d: from כָּלַל; complete; Kelal, an Israelite; Chelal.

H3774.d: probably from כָּרַת in the sense of executioner; (compare טַבָּח) (only collectively in the singular as plural); a Kerethite or life-guardsman; Cherethims, Cherethites.

H3666.d: from כָּנַע in the sense of folding (compare כָּנַס); a package; wares.

H3921.d: from לָכַד; something to capture with, i.e. a noose; being taken.

H3996.d: from בּוֹא; (with or without שֶׁמֶשׁ); an entrance (the place or the act); specifically sunset or the west; also (adverb with preposition) towards; by which came, as cometh, in coming, as men enter into, entering, entrance into, entry, where goeth, going down, [phrase] westward. Compare מוֹבָא.
r: us we pray thee the entrance

H3801.d: or כֻּתֹּנֶת; from an unused root meaning to cover (compare כָּתֵף); a shirt; coat, garment, robe.

H3829.d: the same as לְבוֹנָה; Lebonah, a place in Palestine; Lebonah.

H3601.d: from כָּשֵׁר; compare פֶּלֶךְ; literally a director, i.e. the spindle or shank of adistaff, by which it is twirled; spindle.

H3736.d: from the same as כֶּבֶל; to gird or clothe; clothed.

H3536.d: from כָּבַשׁ; a smelting furnace (as reducing metals); furnace.

H3667.d: from כָּנַע; humiliated; Kenaan, a son a Ham; also the country inhabited by him; Canaan, merchant, traffick.

H3670.d: a primitive root; properly, to project laterally, i.e. probably (reflexive) to withdraw; be removed.

H3824.d: from לָבַב; used also like לֵב; the heart (as the most interior organ); [phrase] bethink themselves, breast, comfortably, courage, ((faint), (tender-) heart(-ed), midst, mind, [idiom] unawares, understanding.

H3720.d: from כָּפַן; hunger (as making to stoop with emptiness and pain); famine.

H3544.d: from כָּהָה; feeble, obscure; somewhat dark, darkish, wax dim, heaviness, smoking.

H3621.d: a form of כָּלֵב; Kelubai, an Israelite; Chelubai.

H3605.d: or (Jeremiah 33:8) כּוֹל; from כָּלַל; properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense); (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

H3679.d: for כַּשְׂדִּי; {a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication, a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people}; Chaldean.

H3564.d: from an unused root meaning properly, to dig through; a pot or furnace (as if excavated); furnace. Compare כִּיר.

H3742.d: of uncertain derivation; a cherub or imaginary figure; cherub, (plural) cherubims.

H3575.d: or (feminine) כּוּתָה; of foreign origin; Cuth or Cuthah, a province of Assyria; Cuth.

H3885.d: or לִין; a primitive root; to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain); abide (all night), continue, dwell, endure, grudge, be left, lie all night, (cause to) lodge (all night, in, -ing, this night), (make to) murmur, remain, tarry (all night, that night).

H3912.d: masculine plural of passive participle of לָטַשׁ; hammered (i.e. oppressed) ones; Letushim, an Arabian tribe; Letushim.

H3680.d: a primitive root; properly, to plump, i.e. fill up hollows; by implication, to cover (for clothing or secrecy); clad self, close, clothe, conceal, cover (self), (flee to) hide, overwhelm. Compare כָּשָׂה.

H3594.d: from כּוּן; properly, a statue, i.e. idol; but used (by euphemism) forsome heathen deity (perhaps corresponding to Priapus or Baal-peor); Chiun.

H3981.d: from אָמַץ; strength, i.e. (plural) resources; force.

H3862.d: probably from an unused root meaning to gather; an assembly; company.

H3593.d: of uncertain derivation; perhaps tumult; battle.

H3664.d: a primitive root; to collect; hence, to enfold; gather (together), heap up, wrap self.

H3622.d: from כָּלָה; completed; Keluhai, an Israelite; Chelluh.

H3506.d: from יָתַר; excellent; Jithran, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite; Ithran.

H3900.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to לֶחֶם; {(for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)}; feast.

H3860.d: from the prepositional prefix meaning to or for and הֵן; popularly for if; hence, therefore; for them (by mistake for prepositional suffix).

H3959.d: the same as לֶשֶׁם; Leshem, a place in Palestine; Leshem.

H3818.d: from לֹא and עַם with pronominal suffix; not my people; Lo-Ammi, the symbolic name of a son of Hosea; Lo-ammi.

H3600.d: a form for כּוּר (only in the dual); a cooking range (consisting of two parallel stones, across which the boiler is set); ranges for pots.

H3629.d: feminine of כְּלִי (only in the plural); a kidney (as an essential organ); figuratively, the mind (as the interior self); kidneys, reins.

H3787.d: a primitive root properly, to be straight or right; by implication, to be acceptable; also to succeed or prosper; direct, be right, prosper.

H3952.d: a primitive root; to lick or lap; lap, lick.

H3760.d: the same as כַּרְמֶל; Karmel, the name of a hill and of a town in Palestine; Carmel, fruitful (plentiful) field, (place).

H3972.d: apparently a form of מאוּם; properly, a speck or point, i.e. (by implication) something; with negative, nothing; fault, [phrase] no(-ught), ought, somewhat, any (no-)thing.

H3795.d: from כָּתַת; beaten, i.e. pure (oil); beaten.

H3729.d: (Aramaic) a root of uncertain correspondence; to fetter; bind.

H3935.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Ladah, an Israelite; Laadah.

H3985.d: a primitive root; to refuse; refuse, [idiom] utterly.

H3529.d: the same as כְּבָר; length; Kebar, a river of Mesopotamia; Chebar. Compare חָבוֹר.

H3794.d: or כִּתִּיִּי; patrial from an unused name denoting Cyprus (only in the plural); a Kittite or Cypriote; hence, an islander in general, i.e. the Greeks or Romans on the shores opposite Palestine; Chittim, Kittim.

H3627.d: from כָּלָה; something prepared, i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon); armour(-bearer), artillery, bag, carriage, [phrase] furnish, furniture, instrument, jewel, that is made of, [idiom] one from another, that which pertaineth, pot, [phrase] psaltery, sack, stuff, thing, tool, vessel, ware, weapon, [phrase] whatsoever.

H3806.d: a primitive root; to butt or pound; bray.

H3671.d: from כָּנַף; an edge or extremity; specifically (of a bird or army) a wing, (of a garment or bedclothing) a flap, (of the earth) a quarter, (of a building) a pinnacle; [phrase] bird, border, corner, end, feather(-ed), [idiom] flying, [phrase] (one an-) other, overspreading, [idiom] quarters, skirt, [idiom] sort, uttermost part, wing(-ed).

H3619.d: xlit kᵉlûb corrected to kᵉlûwb; from the same as כֶּלֶב; a bird-trap (as furnished with a clap-stick or treadle to spring it); hence, a basket (as resembling a wicker cage); basket, cage.

H3635.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to כָּלַל; to complete; finish, make (set) up.

H3949.d: from לָקַח; learned; Likchi, an Israelite; Likhi.

H3775.d: apparently by transposition for כֶּבֶשׂ; a young sheep; lamb.

H3608.d: from כָּלָא; a prison; prison. Compare כִּלְאַיִם, כְּלִיא.

H3542.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to כֹּה; {properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now}; hitherto.

H3512.d: a primitive root; to despond; causatively, to deject; broken, be grieved, make sad.
r: against him therefore he shall be grieved

H3515.d: from כָּבַד; heavy; figuratively in a good sense (numerous) or in a bad sense (severe, difficult, stupid); (so) great, grievous, hard(-ened), (too) heavy(-ier), laden, much, slow, sore, thick.

H3909.d: a form of לָאט or else participle from לוּט; properly, covered, i.e. secret; by implication, incantation; also secrecy or (adverb) covertly; enchantment, privily, secretly, softly.

H3639.d: from כָּלַם; disgrace; confusion, dishonour, reproach, shame.

H3841.d: the same as לִבְנֶה; Libnah, a place in the Desert and one in Palestine; Libnah.

H3551.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to לַהַג in the sense of piercing; a window (as a perforation); window.

H3937.d: a primitive root; to speak in a foreign tongue; strange language.

H3825.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to לֵבָב; {the heart (as the most interior organ);}; heart.

H3566.d: or (Ezra 1:1 (last time),2) כֹּרֶשׁ; from the Persians; Koresh (or Cyrus), the Persian king; Cyrus.

H3663.d: or כְּנַנְיָהוּ; from כָּנַן and יָהּ; Jah has planted; Kenanjah, an Israelite; Chenaniah.

H3604.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to כִּכָּר; a talent; talent.

H3777.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Kesed, a relative of Abraham; Chesed.

H3660.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to כְּמוֹ; so or thus; so, (in) this manner (sort), thus.

H3920.d: a primitive root; to catch (in a net, trap or pit); generally, to capture or occupy; also to choose (by lot); figuratively, to cohere; [idiom] at all, catch (self), be frozen, be holden, stick together, take.
r: straight before him and they took

H3810.d: or לוֹ דבַר; (Samuel 9:4,5), or לִדְבִר; (Joshua 13:26), (probably rather לֹדְבַר ); from לֹא and דֹּבֶר; pastureless; Lo-Debar, a place in Palestine; Debir, Lodebar.

H3689.d: from כָּסַל; properly, fatness, i.e. by implication (literally) the loin (as the seat of the leaf fat) or (generally) the viscera; also (figuratively) silliness or (in a good sense) trust; confidence, flank, folly, hope, loin.

H3524.d: from כָּבַר; vast, whether in extent (figuratively, of power, mighty; of time, aged), or in number, many; [phrase] feeble, mighty, most, much, strong, valiant.

H3853.d: plural of לַהַב; flames; Lehabim, a son of Mizraim, and his descendants; Lehabim.

H3503.d: from יֶתֶר with pron. suffix; his excellence; Jethro, Moses' father-in-law; Jethro. Compare יֶתֶר.

H3537.d: from an unused root meaning to deepen; properly, a pail; but generally of earthenware; a jar for domestic purposes; barrel, pitcher.

H3928.d: or לִמֻּד; from לָמַד; instructed; accustomed, disciple, learned, taught, used.

H3732.d: patrial from כַּפְתֹּר; a Caphtorite (collectively) or native of Caphtor; Caphthorim, Caphtorim(-s).

H3550.d: from כָּהַן; priesthood; priesthood, priest's office.

H3958.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a gem, perhaps the jacinth; ligure.

H3953.d: a primitive root; to gather the after crop; gather.

H3964.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מָה; (as indefinitely) that; [phrase] what.

H3843.d: from לָבַן; a brick (from the whiteness of the clay); (altar of) brick, tile.

H3750.d: probably of foreign origin; the crocus; saffron.

H3725.d: from כָּפַר; expiation (only in plural); atonement.

H3869.d: probably of foreign origin; some kind of nuttree, perhaps the almond; hazel.

H3684.d: from כָּסַל; properly, fat, i.e. (figuratively) stupid or silly; fool(-ish).

H3612.d: perhaps a form of כֶּלֶב, or else from the same root in the sense of forcible; Caleb, the name of three Israelites; Caleb.
